name: Different shell view - AI apps
author: miguel
description: Phone: like the ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity apps. A top bar (menu, your Wizard's name, workspaces), a left drawer (menu or swipe from the left edge) with your open apps, All apps and your chats, and the chat with its composer as the main screen; an app you open fills the screen under the same top bar. Desktop: unchanged for now. One shell view at a time: on turns Orb and Apps off; all off = Desks
